title: UiPath Document Understanding Entities
description: JSON Schema for UiPath Document Understanding entities including digitization results, classification results, extraction results, and field value structures used in intelligent document processing workflows.

DigitizationResult.title: Digitization Result
DigitizationResult.description: The result of submitting a document to the Document Understanding digitization endpoint. The documentId is used in all subsequent processing steps.

documentId.description: Unique identifier assigned to the digitized document. Must be passed to classification, extraction, and validation endpoints. Retained for seven days.

pageCount.description: Number of pages detected and processed in the submitted document

ClassificationResultItem.title: Classification Result Item
ClassificationResultItem.description: A single classification result produced by a classifier model for a document or page range.

classifierId.description: Identifier of the classifier model that produced this result

documentTypeId.description: Identifier of the document type that was identified by the classifier

documentTypeName.description: Human-readable name of the identified document type

confidence.description: Confidence score for this classification (0.0 = no confidence, 1.0 = full confidence)

startPage.description: First page (1-indexed) of the document section assigned this classification

endPage.description: Last page (1-indexed) of the document section assigned this classification

ExtractionResultData.title: Extraction Result Data
ExtractionResultData.description: The structured data extraction output containing all extracted field values and their confidence metadata.

ResultsVersion.description: Version number of the extraction results format schema

DocumentId.description: Document identifier of the document from which data was extracted

Fields.description: Array of extracted field values with confidence scores and metadata

ExtractedField.title: Extracted Field
ExtractedField.description: A single field extracted from a document, including its value, confidence score, and OCR metadata.

FieldId.description: Identifier of the field as defined in the extractor's schema configuration

FieldName.description: Display name of the extracted field

IsMissing.description: True when the field was not found in the document; Value will be null

Value.description: The extracted value with confidence score and page reference

Values.description: For multi-value fields, all extracted occurrences of this field

FieldValue.title: Field Value
FieldValue.description: An extracted field value with associated confidence score, OCR metadata, and page reference.

Value.description: The extracted value; type varies by field definition (string, number, boolean, or structured object)

Reference.description: Reference to the location in the document from which the value was extracted

Confidence.description: Model confidence score for this extracted value (0.0 to 1.0)

OcrConfidence.description: OCR engine confidence score for the text underlying this extracted value

TextType.description: Whether the source text was printed or handwritten

IsManual.description: Whether this value was manually provided during human validation

FieldReference.title: Field Reference
FieldReference.description: A reference to the location within a document where a field value was found.

TextStartIndex.description: Character start index in the document text of the extracted value

TextLength.description: Length in characters of the extracted text

Tokens.description: Individual token references with their bounding box coordinates on the page

FieldToken.title: Field Token
FieldToken.description: A single token (word or text unit) contributing to an extracted field value, with page and position information.

TextStartIndex.description: Character start index of this token in the full document text

TextLength.description: Length in characters of this token

Page.description: Page number (1-indexed) where this token appears

PageWidth.description: Width of the page in document units

PageHeight.description: Height of the page in document units

Left.description: Left coordinate of the token bounding box

Top.description: Top coordinate of the token bounding box

Width.description: Width of the token bounding box

Height.description: Height of the token bounding box

AsyncJobStatus.title: Async Job Status
AsyncJobStatus.description: Status of an asynchronous Document Understanding processing job.

requestId.description: Unique identifier of the asynchronous processing job

status.description: Current execution status of the asynchronous job

errorMessage.description: Error message populated when status is Failed
